node.statement: Mass split of an admissible row. By 1.2, for any row i the coefficients satisfy sum_j P_{ij} = 1 and sum_j max(-P_{ij},0) = nu_i ≤ t; therefore the total positive mass is sum_j max(P_{ij},0) = 1 + nu_i ≤ 1 + t and the total variation is sum_j |P_{ij}| = 1 + 2·nu_i ≤ 1 + 2t. Thus every admissible row is a signed measure of total variation at most 1+2t whose negative part has mass at most t.
